timeline.title: Phase 1: ESMFold Baseline
timeline.description: Ran ESMFold on 183 DB5.5 pairs. Mean DockQ=0.126, median=0.015, success rate=16.4%.

timeline.title: Phase 1: ESMFold TTT (Uniform Masking)
timeline.description: TTT with uniform masking on 33 pairs. Mean DockQ=0.167, success=18.2%. No improvement over baseline on matched pairs (0.167 vs 0.167). Key negative result: TTT reduces perplexity but does not improve docking.

timeline.title: Phase 2: Evoformer Baseline
timeline.description: OpenFold multimer v3 baseline on 5 pilot pairs. Mean DockQ=0.096, success=20%. Best: 1ACB (DockQ=0.370, acceptable).

timeline.title: Phase 2: Evoformer TTT (SGD, lr=1e-4)
timeline.description: SGD-based TTT on 1ACB with lr=1e-4. 30 steps completed but ipTM barely moved (0.14226). DockQ unchanged at 0.041. Other 4 pairs hit CUDA errors.

timeline.title: Phase 2: Evoformer TTT (Adam, lr=1e-3)
timeline.description: Adam optimizer with LoRA on last 4 MSA layers. 1ACB: loss monotonically decreased 0.703->0.546 over 30 steps. DockQ slightly decreased (0.029->0.028). lr=0.01 and 1AK4 errored (LoRA re-application bug).

timeline.title: Next: Fix LoRA merge bug, scale to all 5 pairs
timeline.description: Fix merge_and_unload bug preventing lr=0.01 and additional pairs. Then sweep lr in {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2} with Adam on all 5 pilot pairs.

experiments.name: Evoformer TTT (SGD, lr=1e-4)
experiments.note: SGD lr=1e-4 too small; ipTM barely moved. 4/5 pairs CUDA error.

experiments.name: Evoformer TTT (Adam, lr=1e-3)
experiments.note: Loss monotonically decreasing (0.703->0.546). Most promising direction. lr=0.01 errored (LoRA bug).
